title: CoffeeBench: Benchmarking Long-Horizon LLM Agents in Heterogeneous Multi-Agent Economies
abstract: arXiv:2606.16613v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: LLM agents are increasingly capable of handling complex, long-horizon tasks and may eventually take on business management, a role traditionally performed by humans. Deploying them safely requires monitoring their capabilities and behavior in environments that reflect real economies. We introduce CoffeeBench, a benchmark built on a compact simulation of a coffee supply chain with realistic business mechanics. Six autonomous LLM coding agents run its farmers, roasters, and retailers, and negotiate and trade with one another to maximize their own net income over 90 simulated days. We evaluate eight recent proprietary and open-weight models by letting each run one roaster while a fixed background model runs the other five firms, and scoring that roaster's net income. Claude Sonnet 5.5 earns the highest net income, closely followed by GPT-6 Astra. The leaders sell at higher prices, and the best model also buys its inputs far more cheaply

translated_title: CoffeeBench：在异构多智能体经济中对长程LLM智能体进行基准测试
translated_abstract: LLM智能体处理复杂长程任务的能力日益增强，最终可能承担传统上由人类执行的业务管理工作。要安全地部署它们，需要在反映真实经济的环境中监测其能力和行为。我们提出了CoffeeBench，这是一个基于咖啡供应链紧凑模拟的基准测试，具有真实的商业机制。六个自主LLM编码智能体分别运营其中的农户、烘焙商和零售商，并在90个模拟天中相互谈判和交易，以最大化各自的净收入。我们评估了八个最新的专有和开源权重模型，让每个模型运营一家烘焙商，同时由固定的背景模型运营其他五家公司，并以该烘焙商的净收入作为评分标准。Claude Sonnet 5.5获得了最高的净收入，GPT-6 Astra紧随其后。领先者以更高的价格出售产品，而表现最佳的模型还能以远更低的价格采购原材料。
tldr: CoffeeBench通过模拟咖啡供应链中的多智能体经济，评估LLM智能体的长程商业决策能力，发现Claude Sonnet 5.5凭借更高的售价和更低的采购成本获得最高净收入。
en_tdlr: CoffeeBench is a coffee supply chain simulation benchmark for evaluating long-horizon LLM agents in heterogeneous multi-agent economies, revealing that Claude Sonnet 5.5 achieves the highest net income through higher selling prices and significantly cheaper input purchases.
